targets.method: The transaction date column read as the trade date; equality with the trade date is not established.
targets.words: The transDate column, read as the trade date: the feed carries no separate trade-date column, and whether its date equals the trade date is not established by the census.

Searched every column for a settlement date: none of the 36 columns is a settle or settlement date. transDate and executionTime are the transaction date columns and neither is a settle date; pull_date is the feed pull date.

targets.method: transactionDescription (47 values) through the contract's source_mapping rows for the Inflection type field, then the type word's action word through type_action.
targets.words: No column carries the action word itself. It is computed from the description through the type mapping.

targets.method: transactionDescription (47 values) through the contract's source_mapping rows for the Inflection type field; the Orion cashflow taxonomy keys on the same text.
targets.words: The transactionDescription column (47 values) read through the contract's source_mapping rows for the Inflection type field. The ratified Orion taxonomy keys on the same description text.
The ticker column, named as the security symbol.

targets.method: productName read as the product's name; the census shows its distinct count only.
targets.words: The productName column (1675 distinct values, one per product) read as the security or product name. The census shows its distinct count, not its values.
The noUnits column, named as the units.

targets.method: avgPrice read as the average execution price; navPrice is the NAV and is not used.
targets.words: The avgPrice column, read as the average execution price. navPrice is the fund NAV and is not used as the transaction price. The column is a string in the live schema.
The transAmount column, named as the transaction amount.

Searched every column for a fee amount: no column is named as a fee or charge. The fee descriptions (Management Fee, Trading Expense, Fee Credit and others) are values of transactionDescription, not columns.
The custodianName column, named as the custodian.

targets.method: The description's ratified bucket in the Orion cashflow taxonomy gives the class: NNA as EXTERNAL_IN or EXTERNAL_OUT by the description's direction, Return as INCOME or FEE by the description, Internal as INTERNAL, CorporateAction as CORPORATE_ACTION; a description the taxonomy lacks is UNRESOLVED.
targets.words: The taxonomy keys on the description text; the bucket gives the class.

targets.method: The table row identifier column read as the per-transaction identifier; values not read.
targets.words: The id column, read as the per-transaction identifier by its name. The census holds no values to confirm uniqueness.

targets.method: MEASURED when the description maps to a type word in the contract's source_mapping; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks it; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds it as UNMAPPED.
targets.words: Coverage is a function of how the description is covered by the mapping.
